What it does

Togal.AI reads construction drawings and produces quantities automatically, which is the part of estimating that normally eats entire evenings. You upload plans, it identifies rooms, areas and assemblies, and you adjust rather than measure from scratch. It is aimed squarely at plan-based bidding, so it matters most if you price from drawings rather than from a site visit.

Where the AI actually is

Reads plan drawings and identifies areas, rooms and assemblies to produce quantities automatically.

Pros

  • Cuts takeoff time dramatically on plan-based bids
  • Removes the most tedious part of estimating
  • Cloud based, so no local setup

Cons

  • Aimed at commercial/plan-based work; overkill for small service jobs

Who it suits

Built with General contractors, Remodelers & carpenters in mind. Contractors who bid from plans and spend hours on manual takeoffs.
